label: Renaming straight-line code
subgoals: Number the versions of each variable in order of assignment
Rewrite each read to the most recent version above it
Treat each version as a separate net

label: Phi functions at joins
subgoals: List the variables assigned in either arm
Place one phi per such variable at the join
Read each phi as a multiplexer on the branch condition

label: Pruned SSA
subgoals: Compute which variables are read after the join before being overwritten
Keep phis only for those live variables
Remove dead phis with dead-code elimination
